scope: Isolated full-source Didelta art comparison; not island approval, memory benchmark or production adoption
ownership: Canonical shared original normal and other maps are retained. At most ONE private control/ASTC normal is live; private GPU and CPU mip references are released before another is loaded.
sourceIdentityBoundary: Small source and artifact manifests are SHA-verified in the page. Frozen full binary SHA values are shown with actual transfer byte count and parsed format; full binary SHA is not recomputed in-browser, avoiding another giant buffer copy. Root must verify file identities around native capture.
renderingPolicy: Static on demand, native devicePixelRatio, original studio renderer/lights/camera presets, full source geometry/maps; no simulation or frame-rate claim
capturePolicy: Actual default framebuffer readPixels after cancellable GPU fence; raw top-left RGBA hash and alpha statistics retained. A reproducible sRGB reference composite uses the actual premultiplied buffer and verified CSS #28312f, then a separate opaque 2D encoder saves PNG. PNG must match reference presentation hash, not raw hash. Native display pixel equality is not claimed.
